The original app saved player data but not enough information to resume a round. These original values are preserved as a read-only recovery scorecard.

1. Add at least two players in seating order. Choose the dealer, deal direction, trump mode and scoring strategy before Start game. Saved players are an optional library.

2. Predict the tricks you will take. Bidding starts after the dealer, who bids last. Total bids must differ from the cards dealt. The latest bid can be edited until the next player bids.

3. After play, Won means an exact prediction; Lost means a missed prediction. The app rejects mathematically impossible combinations. Every missed bid scores zero.

Default: an exact bid, including zero, earns 10 + bid. Exact zero earns 10; a successful bid of three earns 13 points.

Aggressive: exact zero earns 7. Another exact bid earns 10 + bid. If the exact bid is strictly greater than half the cards dealt, add min(cards dealt, 10). With one card, exact bid 1 earns 12. With two cards, exact bid 1 is exactly half and earns 11; exact bid 2 earns 14. With 12 cards, exact bid 7 earns 27 and exact bid 8 earns 28. Only the additional bonus is capped at 10; the total score is not capped. A missed bid above half still earns zero.

Custom: choose the exact-zero reward, another exact bid’s base reward, points per successfully bid trick, and whether to enable the same majority bonus. Live examples show the result of your values. How scoring works is available beside the selector and from the round.

Change scoring strategy in Game options. Before anyone bids, a change applies immediately. Once bidding starts, it is scheduled for the next round number; the current round keeps its rules. The round screen identifies the active strategy and any scheduled change. Completed rounds always keep the strategy recorded for them. An unapplied change does not silently carry into Play again.

The dealer advances after each round. Fixed trump cycles through Spades, Diamonds, Clubs and Hearts by round number. In Custom trump mode, trump is chosen at the table. Structural changes after bidding starts require a confirmed round restart. Leaving the app preserves your game; Resume from Home.

History: open a completed round, choose Edit round, correct bids and Won/Lost results, and review the points preview before saving. The original round strategy applies. A valid edit updates totals, rankings and graphs atomically, with an audit record; current-round progress stays intact. Manual score corrections remain separate history entries.

Final results: compare standings, exact-bid percentage, highest successful bid and the longest exact-prediction streak. Select players in cumulative-score and points-per-round graphs; tap a round for its cards, strategy and results. Strategy changes are marked on the timeline. Statistics count only rounds that each player actually played. Won/Lost does not reveal actual tricks after a missed bid, so the app does not invent them. Highlights identify significant repeated achievements such as the highest single-round score, most exact rounds and frequent zero bids.

Play again reuses the table, seating order and game settings, including the last active strategy. Review the scoring selector before starting. The current game and results remain until you confirm Start game.
